paragraphs: Alder & Vine operates two properties: Harbor Hotel on the coast and Hilltop Lodge in the mountains. This handbook covers both. Where a rule differs by property, the property document governs.
Front desk teams at both properties are staffed around the clock. The night auditor handles arrivals between 11:00 PM and 6:00 AM.
documents.title: Welcome to Alder & Vine

paragraphs: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM at both properties. Guests must present photo identification and the payment card used for the booking. Rooms are held until midnight unless the guest has called ahead.

Early arrival: before noon a $25 early arrival fee applies when a room is ready; between noon and 3:00 PM there is no fee if the room is ready. If no room is ready, guests may store luggage free of charge.
Standard departure time is 11:00 AM. Guests who need to stay later can join the extended departure programme, which keeps the room until 1:00 PM on the day of departure.

Extended departure pricing: Vine Circle members pay nothing for the 1:00 PM departure. Non-members pay $35. Staying past 1:00 PM costs half the nightly rate, and past 4:00 PM a full additional night is charged.
documents.title: Check-in and departure — all properties

paragraphs: Harbor Hotel welcomes dogs weighing up to 40 pounds. Cats and other animals are not accepted at Harbor Hotel. A maximum of two dogs per room.
The pet fee at Harbor Hotel is $50 per stay, not per night. Pet rooms are on the first and second floors only, and dogs must be leashed in the lobby and corridors.
A fenced pet relief area with waste stations sits behind the east wing. Dogs may not be left unattended in the room; pet sitting can be arranged through the front desk with 24 hours notice.
documents.title: Pets — Harbor Hotel

paragraphs: Hilltop Lodge welcomes dogs and cats of any size in its cabins. A maximum of two pets per cabin. The main lodge rooms are pet-free.
The pet fee at Hilltop Lodge is $30 per night. A refundable $100 pet deposit is taken at check-in and returned after the cabin is inspected at departure.
Pets may join their owners on the meadow trails but must stay off the dining room terrace. A dog washing station with warm water stands beside the equipment barn.
documents.title: Pets — Hilltop Lodge

paragraphs: Harbor Hotel parking is in the attached garage. Self-parking costs $28 per night with in-and-out privileges, billed to the room.
Attendant parking is available at the main entrance for $45 per night. Attendants are on duty from 6:00 AM to midnight and hold guests' keys at the front desk podium.
Four electric vehicle chargers stand on level B2 of the garage. Charging is free for registered guests; a charging cable is required, as cables are not provided.
Oversized vehicles and trailers cannot use the garage, which has a clearance of 6 feet 6 inches. They are directed to the municipal lot two blocks north, at $18 per night.
documents.title: Parking and charging — Harbor Hotel

paragraphs: Parking at Hilltop Lodge is free. The gravel surface lot beside the main lodge holds 60 cars and is first come, first served.
Two electric vehicle chargers stand at the lodge entrance. Charging costs $12 per session for guests and is started from the front desk.
In winter the lot is ploughed by 6:00 AM. Guests arriving during a snowstorm may use the equipment barn as temporary covered parking when space allows.
documents.title: Parking and charging — Hilltop Lodge

paragraphs: Standard rate bookings can be cancelled free of charge until 48 hours before the arrival date. After that point the first night is charged. Every cancellation is confirmed by email.
Saver rate bookings are prepaid and non-refundable. The dates of a saver booking can be moved once, up to 7 days before arrival, for a $20 change fee.
Group bookings of ten or more rooms follow a 30-day free cancellation window, set out in the group contract.
When the county closes the mountain road for weather, Hilltop Lodge bookings affected by the closure can be cancelled free of charge at any time, regardless of rate type.
documents.title: Cancellation and changes — all properties

paragraphs: Breakfast is served at Saltline, the Harbor Hotel restaurant, from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM daily.
The breakfast buffet costs $24 per adult; children under six eat free and children aged six to twelve pay half price. Breakfast is not included in standard room rates at Harbor Hotel.
Room service breakfast can be ordered from 6:00 AM using the card in the room; a $6 delivery charge applies.
documents.title: Breakfast — Harbor Hotel

paragraphs: Breakfast at Hilltop Lodge is served in the lodge dining room from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM.
Breakfast is included in the cabin rate at Hilltop Lodge. Lodge room guests pay $16 per person.
A packed trail breakfast — a sandwich, fruit and coffee in a thermos — can be ordered at the front desk by 8:00 PM the evening before, at no charge for cabin guests.
documents.title: Breakfast — Hilltop Lodge

paragraphs: Complimentary standard Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and public areas at both properties. The network name is AlderVine-Guest; no password is needed, and guests sign in with their room number and surname.
A premium tier with higher bandwidth for video calls and streaming costs $9.99 per day per room. Vine Circle Gold members and above receive the premium tier free of charge.
Meeting rooms have wired ethernet points. Standard Wi-Fi is not recommended for uploading large files; the business centre at Harbor Hotel has two wired workstations.
documents.title: Wi-Fi and connectivity — all properties

paragraphs: The indoor pool at Harbor Hotel is open from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult. There is no lifeguard on duty.
The spa offers massages and facials by appointment, booked at the spa desk or through the front desk. The spa area includes a steam room and cedar soaking tubs; swimwear is required in the tubs.
Pool towels are provided at the pool entrance. The outdoor sun terrace opens from May to September, weather permitting.
documents.title: Pool and spa — Harbor Hotel

paragraphs: Guided hikes leave from Hilltop Lodge at 9:00 AM on Saturdays and Sundays, led by a ranger. The hike is free for guests; sign up at the front desk the day before.
In winter, snowshoes can be rented from the equipment barn for $18 per day, and cross-country skis for $26 per day including poles.
In summer, kayaks on the lake cost $22 per hour and bicycles are complimentary for guests, from the equipment barn.
documents.title: Activities — Hilltop Lodge

paragraphs: Both properties provide step-free access to the lobby, restaurants and a selection of rooms. Harbor Hotel has six accessible rooms; Hilltop Lodge has two accessible cabins.
Service animals are welcome at both properties at no charge and are not subject to the pet policies or pet fees described in the property documents.
Hearing kits with visual alarms can be fitted to any room on request. Accessible parking spaces stand closest to each entrance, and in the Harbor garage on level B1 near the lift.
documents.title: Accessibility — all properties

paragraphs: A shuttle runs between Harbor Hotel and the airport every 40 minutes from 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM. The fare is $15 per person each way; seats are booked at the front desk.
Hilltop Lodge has no shuttle service. The lodge can book a partner taxi firm for the two-hour mountain drive; the typical fare is $140 per car.
Children under five ride the Harbor shuttle free of charge when seated with an adult.
documents.title: Airport transfers

paragraphs: Vine Circle members earn 10 points for every dollar spent on rooms at both properties. Points expire after 24 months without a stay.
Silver status starts at 5 nights in a year, Gold at 15 nights and Platinum at 40 nights.
Gold and Platinum members receive premium Wi-Fi free of charge, a 1:00 PM extended departure at no charge, and a welcome drink at check-in.
Points can be redeemed for free nights: 12,000 points for a standard room night at either property, outside blackout dates at Christmas and New Year.
documents.title: Vine Circle loyalty programme

paragraphs: The Harbor Hotel ballroom seats 220 guests for dinner and 300 for a reception. The smaller Clipper Room seats 40.
Wedding dinners and receptions in the ballroom use the event packages, which include the room, standard audio-visual equipment and Wi-Fi.
A catering minimum of $2,500 applies.
Events must end by 11:00 PM under the town noise ordinance. Outdoor ceremonies on the terrace are permitted until 9:00 PM.
documents.title: Meetings and events — Harbor Hotel
